title: TAKKT AG lowers 2026 forecast after October cyberattack
date_note: Date of TAKKT's ad-hoc disclosure; the notice refers to the cyberattack only as 'of October' and gives no day.
geo_basis: company headquarters as given in the notice
summary: In an ad-hoc notice of 20 November, TAKKT AG said the October cyberattack restricted order processing and delivery. It said order intake, processing, delivery and invoicing are largely restored. The board now expects organic revenue of around minus 7 percent, an adjusted EBITDA margin slightly below 2 percent and free cash flow between minus 30 and minus 10 million euros.
plain: German company TAKKT says an October cyberattack disrupted orders and deliveries, which are now largely restored, and it has cut its 2026 financial forecast.
exec: A cyberattack disrupted a listed company's order handling and delivery and led it to lower its 2026 revenue, margin and cash flow outlook.
impact: Order processing and delivery restricted; 2026 forecast lowered by the company.

validation.note: TAKKT's own EQS ad-hoc notice (MAR Art. 17) as republished by finanznachrichten.de; no second publisher read. The notice does not name the systems affected or the attacker.
